Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- High chance of performing a critical hit
- High chance of evading enemy's attack
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
*Before receiving an attack within the turn*
- Damage reduction rate 60%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When receiving an attack*
- DEF 200%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 15%{passiveImg:up_g} when HP is 30% or less
*After receiving an attack*
- Chance of evading enemy's attack 10%{passiveImg:up_g}
*For every attack performed*
- {passiveImg:forever}ATK 150%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 300%)
*Every time the character performs 2 or more attacks in battle*
- ATK 666%{passiveImg:up_g} and performs a critical hit within the character's
next attacking turn
*When there is another "DAIMA", "Majin Power" or "Demonic Power"
Category ally attacking in the same turn*
- All allies' Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 40%{passiveImg:up_g}
- {passiveImg:once}Changes Ki Spheres: All to cookies(*), TEQ & STR
(*excluding Ki Spheres with a Dragon Ball)
*1 or more sweet treat Ki Spheres obtained*
- {passiveImg:once}Ki +3 and launches an additional attack
- {passiveImg:forever}Chance of evading enemy's attack 20%{passiveImg:up_g}
- {passiveImg:forever}Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 60%{passiveImg:up_g} for the character and
allies whose names include "Majin Duu"
